elements.description: Tree diagram titled 'Household consumption per capita—a decomposed identity'. Root box (teal): 'Household consumption per capita'. It branches into two orange boxes: 'Propensity to consume' and 'Household income per capita'. 'Household income per capita' branches into two grey boxes: 'Share of adults' and 'Income per adult'. 'Income per adult' branches into two yellow boxes: 'Labor income per adult' and 'Non-labor income per adult'. 'Labor income per adult' branches into two blue boxes: 'Share of occupied adults' and 'Labor income per occupied adult'. Formulas shown alongside: above 'Share of adults' is n_A/n; above 'Share of occupied adults' is n_o/n_A; below the grey 'Income per adult' box is (1/n_A) Σ(i=1 to n) y_i; below 'Non-labor income per adult' is (1/n_A) Σ(i∈A) y_i^NL; below 'Labor income per occupied adult' is (1/n_o) Σ(i∈A) y_i^L; and a standalone label Y_pc appears at the left of the lower area. Note: An illustration of Equation 5.
